assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square original card portrait for Moss & Ember
Primary request: An original portrait for Ironroot, one immense, slow foundry-and-woodland melee defender formed from ironstone, roots, and iron.
Scene/backdrop: A softly blurred foundry threshold meeting damp woodland; keep the background quiet.
Subject: One squat, broad, asymmetrical rootstone colossus. Its body is a split ironstone trunk wrapped in thick twisting roots, separated shale plates, weathered iron braces, a few copper clamps, and moss. Make its front-facing nonhuman face unmistakable and large enough to read in a small portrait: a carved ironstone mask below a branch-like root brow, two clearly separated narrow amber crevice eyes, and simple wedge-shaped stone nose and mouth ridges. Keep roots away from the eyes and face. One oversized root arm holds a single broad dark-iron slab blade point-down beside the body; keep the blade separate from the face.
Style/medium: Original hand-painted 2.5D game-card illustration with softly sculpted forms, broad controlled brushwork, matte stone, iron, rootwood, moss, and copper, simplified for thumbnail readability.
Composition/framing: Close square portrait from the upper legs to above the head, one centered massive figure; face in the upper middle, broad blade fully recognizable at one side, strong uneven silhouette and generous edge margin.
Lighting/mood: Muted warm foundry light on the iron and copper with cool woodland shade; steady and ancient.
Color palette: Charcoal iron, shale gray, deep root brown, moss green, aged copper, and restrained amber in the face.
Materials/textures: Split stone plates, fibrous roots, hammered iron braces, worn copper clamps, moss in crevices, softly painted slate-and-fern backdrop.
Text (verbatim): None.
Constraints: Keep the two-eye stone face clearly visible and keep this design root-based rather than dressed in a conventional suit of armor. One creature and one blade only.
Avoid: Closed human knight armor, horned helmet, symmetrical armored-soldier stance, paired swords, polished blue or violet armor, robotic joints, copied commercial game characters or silhouettes, photorealism, glossy plastic, flat vector art, fireball effects, text, logos, UI, frame, border, watermark.
